04 / TECHNICAL SYSTEMS / SYSTEMS / LINEAGE

One architecture. Many contributing systems.

Asentxia’s supporting work spans execution, state, authority, gateways, governance research, and applied systems. Placement labels matter: lineage is not the same as current integration.

EXECUTION AND STATE

Execution and state

NEXUS supplies constrained WASM/WASI execution lineage under explicit capabilities. AEON-IQ contributes persistent cognitive-state lineage. Genesis Runtime contributes identity and authority-lifecycle lineage.

  • NEXUSTested execution lineage
  • AEON-IQStandalone state lineage
  • Genesis RuntimeTested, non-production authority lineage

NETWORK AND GOVERNANCE

Network and governance

Agent-Bridge / NOEMA Gateway is capability-gateway and coordination lineage. AEON Program is an optional chain-backed adapter and is not core DCA. Organization-Invariant Authority research informs Regency Core’s authority model.

A research result or standalone implementation does not prove Continuum or Regency integration.

APPLIED WORK

Applied work

Aether is a governed autonomous-engineering applied system. Other applied directions span cyber defense, scientific computing, real-time data, controlled markets, transaction security, and visual intelligence; each requires its own evidence record.
